name: Inoue Ayumi
source:
An average student in school, she is a reserved girl. Adept at housework, she is seen as the perfect wife. Despite being timid, she has a strong sense of justice that can't overlook crimes. She deeply loves her husband who was her childhood friend.
She was the sister of the protagonist's neighbor, and his first love.
